capabilities: Browse created and modified notes by selecting a date
Show month activity as an optional heatmap with hover previews
Filter the calendar by folder or tag and exclude folders
Open or create a date's daily note from the core Daily notes settings
Display optional Chinese lunar dates, festivals, and solar terms
extras: The plugin interface is currently Chinese only; the README is available in English and Simplified Chinese. The listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or later. Modification history is only collected while the plugin runs, so past edits cannot be reconstructed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view for finding notes by the day they were created or edited.
summary: Sidebar calendar that lists notes created or modified on each date, with an activity heatmap, folder/tag filters, lunar dates, and daily-note shortcuts.
